activeDecision.label:
Check for active rental or material booking
(any assigned machine / material order)

flowNote: Green is done. Amber is in progress. Grey is not started. Yellow diamonds are decisions, not screens. After a valid OTP the app checks whether the mobile is already registered. Existing user: the app checks for an active rental or material booking (any assigned machine / material order). If yes, Quick Booking opens first (rental is drawn; material uses the same accept/reject pattern); Close/Back goes to Home. If none, go to Home. New user: Sign Up Completed popup — Contact us to Register opens Help & Support, or Register Yourself continues registration and then Home. Invalid OTP stays on the OTP screen. Rental-owner Quick Booking (9000000001) is done — 40 isolated cases. Dev blocker #16: Assign machine Confirm stays disabled when operators are busy, so Accept cannot complete. Material Vendor and Operator Quick Booking are not started. Operator-specific existing-user landing after OTP is not on this chart yet.
existingUserEvidenceNote: 18 Sep live on 9000000001: pending rentals open Quick Booking after OTP. Material uses the same page when an order is waiting. Operator existing-user landing will be added when specified.
